summary: A Rust JSON web service on Axum and Tokio with one error format, request logs and a clean shutdown.
description: Write a Rust HTTP service on Axum and Tokio. One in-memory notes resource proves the shape: create, read and paged list routes, strict JSON input, and one error envelope for bad input, misses, wrong methods, timeouts and panics, all from a single status table. Request ids, JSON access logs, a body size limit and a request timeout come from tower-http. The server stops cleanly on SIGINT or SIGTERM and ships a health-check flag for containers. The recipe picks no database, sign-in or hosting; the store sits behind a trait a database can implement.
seoDescription: A Rust Axum API recipe with one JSON error envelope, request ids and logs, timeouts, graceful shutdown, strict clippy lints and router tests.

projectExamples.title: Internal pricing service
projectExamples.description: Illustrative: replace notes with price rules that other services look up over HTTP. Persistence and access control are work the project still has to add.

plain.whatItIs: A starter web service written in the Rust language that answers requests with JSON data, with clear error replies, request logs and a clean shutdown.
goodAt: Fast backends that websites, phone apps or other services call for data
Services that must report every error in one consistent format
Small services that run as one file inside a container
notGoodAt: Projects that need a database or sign-in from the start; you add both yourself.
Pages and screens for people to click through; use a web app stack for those.
